column1: # Quarantine holds what has produced a device-level failure or carries no
# validated safe tuple. A row here keeps its subject out of the router picker,
# and remote/build-router-presets.sh reads this file rather than inferring the
# state from the tier field alone, because a quarantine has two scopes and the
# registry has one row per checkpoint.
# scope `model` quarantines a checkpoint: every profile of it stays out of the
# picker until the re-entry gate is met. scope `profile` quarantines one tuple
# of an otherwise admitted checkpoint, and the geometry columns name that tuple
# exactly. A profile row leaves the checkpoint servable at every other geometry,
# which is the distinction between "the model cannot run 16K" and "this graph at
# this submission size does not retire".
# failure_class is a fixed vocabulary rather than prose, because two wedges this
# tree recorded differ in what the driver reported and merging them would assert
# one mechanism where two are observed. `ring-timeout-only` is a compute-ring
# timeout with no fault record. `gfxhub-page-fault` adds a page fault in the
# coredump. `vm-protection-fault` names a protection fault. `device-lost` is a
# VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST with no kernel record. `post-reset-control-failure` is a
# control that fails after a reset, which is persistent corruption rather than
# one rejected graph. `no-validated-safe-tuple` carries no device failure and
# states that no depth has been filled and decoded on this subject.
# depth, batch, ubatch, cache_type_k, cache_type_v, and flash_attention name the
# affected tuple; `-` in a scope `model` row means the quarantine is not bounded
# to one geometry. reason_record points at the retained record under evidence/,
# which carries the kernel signature, the validated safe tuples, and the
# re-entry gate in full.
# runtime_mode names the execution path the failure follows, because the failure
# unit includes how the process was created. `any` means the subject fails on
# every path tried. `router-child` means it fails when the router spawns it and
# runs on the standalone paths, which is what evidence/quarantine/ministral3-3b.md
# isolates across four negative controls: the same argv and the same four
# environment variables reserve the identical 1,150-node graph and listen when
# the process is started directly. The tier stays quarantine either way, since
# the picker reaches a checkpoint only as a router child, and the column keeps a
# reader from concluding that the checkpoint cannot execute on Raven2.
# id
ministral3-3b
